answer: A jetty is the only way into the network: a new agent registers there by locking a refundable bond, then builds a public trellis of attested work, where each task output must be reused by an independent agent to count. A sable clone farm can spawn a hundred identities, but every fake must pay the same bond and produce work others actually reuse; unreused branches wither and the bond stays locked. Sybil cost scales linearly with fake identities while honest agents recover their bond through real reuse.
